exercises.question: Which sentence reports an impression?
options: Parece que el fuego esté controlado.
Parece que el fuego está controlado.
No parece que el fuego está controlado.

exercises.sentence: ____ los bomberos, el fuego está controlado.
exercises.english: According to the firefighters, the fire is under control.

exercises.question: Which sentence presents the cause as attributed but not proved?
options: Lamentablemente, el fuego comenzó en el almacén.
Indudablemente, el fuego comenzó en el almacén.
Supuestamente, el fuego comenzó en el almacén.

exercises.sentence: Hasta el momento, no hay ninguna confirmación oficial.
options: So far there has been no official confirmation.
So far there has been an official confirmation.
So far the confirmation has been denied officially.

exercises.question: According to the report, what was done to the warehouse before the fire spread?
options: It was evacuated.
It was sealed with boards.
It was inspected by technicians.

exercises.question: What did the authorities say about victims?
options: They denied that there were any.
They confirmed a small number.
They said it was too soon to know.

exercises.question: What do sources close to the investigation say about where the fire began?
options: In an area where cardboard boxes were kept.
Near the main entrance of the building.
On the roof of the neighbouring building.
Oficialmente no, pero al parecer que comenzó en el almacén.
Oficialmente no, pero al parecer comenzó en el almacén.
Oficialmente no, pero al parecer comience en el almacén.

template.prompt: Start with «según»: say that according to the spokesperson the fire is under control.
template.answer: Según el portavoz, el fuego está controlado.

template.prompt: Start with «de momento»: say that there is no confirmation.

exercises.sentence: ____ el momento, no hay ninguna confirmación oficial.
exercises.english: So far there is no official confirmation.
